as_told.title: Mitchell hears of Roswell from residents and von Braun

plain: Edgar Mitchell, an Apollo astronaut who walked on the Moon, believed that an alien spacecraft crashed near Roswell, New Mexico, in 1947 and that the government recovered it. Michels says that as an astronaut Mitchell "heard all sorts of things about Roswell from people at all levels." A guest named Maaneli Derakhshani says Mitchell was "very clear" about this belief. An online researcher who goes by RedPandaKoala adds that the rocket scientist Wernher von Braun later told Mitchell that he could "corroborate what you were hearing back home about Roswell." If true, it would mean people at the top of the space programme knew of the crash.
